parsed.production_notes: The ad combines human-recorded footage of the presenter/learner with an AI-generated humanoid robot avatar set in a likely AI-generated cafe background.
parsed.interaction_pattern: AI tutor quizzes a learner, identifies mistakes, provides live correction, and the learner repeats the correct phrase.
parsed.audio_track: Spoken dialogue in Hindi and English between a human learner and an AI tutor avatar. There is no background music.

She has long, wavy, dark brown hair with lighter highlights, styled with a side part and face-framing layers. Her features include large, expressive dark brown eyes, well-defined eyebrows, and a friendly smile.

Character A says: My name is Neha.

Character A says: I have 22.

Character A says: पर टाइम नहीं मिलता। [But I don't get the time.]
